title: Tangy Rocket Wrap
description: A refreshing and gluten-free wrap filled with tangy slaw and crunchy rocket.
instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the crispy bacon until crispy, set aside.
In the same pan, add mayonnaise and apple cider vinegar. Whisk until combined.
Add the rocket salad to the pan and toss with the tangy dressing.
Warm the gluten-free wrap in the microwave for 10 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the rocket salad mixture onto the wrap, followed by crispy bacon.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
Cut the wrap in half and serve immediately.
